features.title: Parts List
features.description: Automatically generate complete parts lists from your cabinet designs. No more manual counting.

features.title: Cut List

features.title: Print Ready
features.description: Export professional cut sheets and labels ready for the workshop floor.

withBullets: Boards nested to keep waste down
Every part sized by the same rules
compareNote: The demo job above: 85 parts on 10 boards, 9% waste and 52.25 m of edging. CabinetOS works out sizes from what you enter, using the rules shown below. Check the cut list against your drawing and your site measurements before you cut: what gets cut is your call.
sizesIntro: You enter the outside size of a unit. CabinetOS splits it into boards with the same few rules every time, so any size on the cut list can be checked by hand. Here they are, worked through on one wardrobe.
sizesEnterText: The outside size, the board and what goes inside. Everything else on the cut list comes from the rules below.

sizesRules.title: The box
sizesRules.text: The top and bottom run the full width of the unit. The sides fit between them, so a side is the height less the plinth and two board thicknesses.

sizesRules.title: The plinth
sizesRules.text: A 100 mm plinth sits under the box, as wide as the unit. The box is what's left above it.

sizesRules.title: The back
sizesRules.text: An 18 mm back fits inside the box, between the sides and between the top and bottom, so it's as high as the sides.

sizesRules.title: Shelves and the rail
sizesRules.text: Shelves are 2 mm short at each side so they drop in, and stop 2 mm back from the front. Behind them is the back. The hanging rail is as long as a shelf.

sizesRules.title: Doors
sizesRules.text: Doors cover the front of the box: 3 mm short at the top, flush at the bottom, 2 mm in at each outside edge and 4 mm apart in a pair. A door over 600 mm wide gets a warning to use two.

sizesRules.title: Edging
sizesRules.text: Edging tape goes on the front edge of the top, bottom, sides and shelves, and on all four edges of each door. The back and the plinth get none.

sizesDrawnNote: Not to scale: boards and gaps are drawn bigger so you can see them.
sizesPartsTitle: The whole wardrobe, part by part
sizesPartsIntro: What the cut list gives for this wardrobe and where each size comes from. Each part is drawn to the same scale; blue edges get edging tape.
sizesNote: These are the app's starting settings. Change the board thickness, the gaps or how the box goes together, and every size follows. The cut list is only as good as what goes in: check it against your drawing and your site measurements before you cut.

faq.question: Who is Cabinetos for?
faq.answer: Cabinet makers, carpenters, kitchen fitters, and anyone who builds furniture from sheet materials.

faq.question: Does it work with any board size?
faq.answer: Yes — you can set custom board dimensions, thickness, and even grain direction preferences.

faq.question: Can I save and reuse projects?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Save templates for common cabinet types and reuse them across projects.

faq.question: What makes it different from other cut list tools?
faq.answer: Cabinetos is built by a working carpenter who understands the real workshop workflow — it's practical, not theoretical.
